description: This file defines the public interface and classes for a disk cache system used in network operations, including backend creation, cache entries, and file operations.

classes.name: Backend
classes.description: Interface for disk cache backend, supporting operations like open, create, delete, and iteration over cache entries.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry, supporting data read/write, sparse data, and metadata.

classes.name: EntryResult
classes.description: Represents the result of an open or create cache entry operation, owning the Entry object.

classes.name: RangeResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a range query on cache data, including available byte ranges.

classes.name: BackendFileOperations
classes.description: Interface for file operations in a sandboxed environment, including file creation, deletion, enumeration, and info retrieval.

classes.name: UnboundBackendFileOperations
classes.description: Interface for file operations not yet bound to a sequence, to be bound later.

classes.name: BackendFileOperationsFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating BackendFileOperations instances.

classes.name: TrivialFileOperations
classes.description: A simple implementation of BackendFileOperations using base functions.

methods.name: CreateCacheBackend
methods.description: Creates a cache backend instance with specified parameters, handling errors asynchronously.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadForTesting
methods.description: Flushes internal cache threads to ensure all I/O is complete.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadAsynchronouslyForTesting
methods.description: Asynchronously flushes internal cache threads, invoking callback when done.
